mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation (reservation_date, reservation_phone, reservation_time, reservation_name, reservation_adult_count, reservation_child_count, reservation_count, reservation_status, child_seat, reservation_note, table_id) VALUES (#{reservationDate}, #{reservationPhone}, #{reservationTime}, #{reservationName}, #{reservationAdultCount}, #{reservationChildCount}, #{reservationCount}, #{reservationStatus}, #{childSeat}, #{reservationNote}, #{tableId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM reservation WHERE reservation_date = #{reservationDate} AND reservation_phone = #{reservationPhone} AND reservation_status = 0
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(child_seat), 0) FROM reservation WHERE reservation_date = #{reservationDate} AND reservation_time = #{reservationTime}

t.table_status, -- 從 Table 表取得狀態 t.table_capacity -- 從 Table 表取得容量 FROM reservation r JOIN tables t ON r.table_id = t.table_id WHERE r.reservation_date = #{reservationDate} ORDER BY r.reservation_time ASC
